audit.why: Lane difficulty is stated as an even skill matchup (5.5/10) gated on who lands Light Binding first; this matches the packet win rate (53.45%) and level chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Power spikes were stated in generic template language ("Pop Blossom online", "first item: root-blooms delete") without naming Lux's real cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Light Binding is a flat 10s cooldown at all ranks, and Lux's R is 60/50/40s — both are concrete numbers that should anchor the spike/cooldown text instead of vague phrasing.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.spikes, breakdown.mid and dosFull[1].d to cite the 10s Q cooldown and 1175 range directly.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flagged two unmentioned interactions: Lux's W (Prismatic Barrier) shield absorbing burst, and her P (Illumination) auto-reset being the real combo tell rather than a cast.
audit.why: Both interactions decide who wins an all-in and were not present in currentText.
audit.corrected: Added dosFull entries and cooldowns text referencing the 10s Q timer as the commit window; the shield/auto-reset interactions were not added as new bullets since dosFull/dontsFull already had 3 entries each and no null slot existed to append into without exceeding the fixed count — flagged in notes instead.
